file_upload_prompts.label: Upload SOW, change orders, or final QC report

sections.label: Notice Details
sections.instructions: ONLY a two-column markdown table: Issued To, Project, Job #, Reference Documents, Issued By (omit Reference Documents row if not provided). No prose.

sections.label: Declaration of Substantial Completion
sections.instructions: Open with one short formal sentence declaring substantial completion. Then an emphasized line with the completion_date, then one short paragraph from completion_statement. Plain, formal, no marketing.

sections.label: Scope of Work Completed
sections.instructions: A markdown table: Area | Quantity | Completion Status from scope_completed, plus a PROJECT TOTAL row. Right-align Quantity.

sections.label: Scope Boundary & Handoff
sections.instructions: One or two short paragraphs from scope_boundary stating where this scope terminates and what falls to other parties. Factual, no embellishment.

sections.label: Site Conditions at Completion
sections.instructions: A checklist: render each line of site_conditions as a '- [x] …' markdown checkbox item. Omit the section if none provided.

sections.label: Acknowledgments
sections.instructions: A tight bullet list crediting the parties from acknowledgments. Omit if none provided.

sections.label: Signatures
sections.instructions: For each line of signatories, render a block: the ROLE label, then Name, Title, Company on separate lines, then 'Signature & Date'. Separate the parties clearly so they read as parallel sign-off columns.
